PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Results-driven Finance Operations Analyst with 3 years of progressive experience in Investment Banking Operations. 
Expertise in complex data analysis, financial reconciliation, and validation of financial transactions and reports. Strong track 
record in identifying and resolving discrepancies, and contributing to process improvement initiatives. Proven ability to 
communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, mentor junior team members, and maintain adherence to 
industry best practices and regulatory requirements.

Oct 2025 – June 2026 | Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

critical escalations.
